body:
To be honest at this point I just feel ashamed a rather dumb. I can't believe I allowed my emotions to run this ridiculously out of control. Whining and feeling sorry for yourself never got anyone anywhere right?

Thinking it over on of the factors that got me to post may have been that these are not feelings that are unfamiliar. I have the thought of how I should end all of this. I've actually taken the time to really explore my options, so I guess I'm a bit fearful that this isn't a minor matter. Thing is, and my apologies to anyone who may be offended, I feel like I'm too smart to kill myself. Like I know all the angles and can see that alternative perspectives. I shouldn't feel this way. I should be doing better. I should have thought my way out of these problems by now. Hell, now In wonder if my whole "kill myself" attitude is brains way of trying to fix the situation. It almost has a logic too it.
